facts.content: Patient has a 3-day history of watery to loose diarrhea and vomiting, with a serious fever.
facts.source_text: CC: 3-day hx watery→loose diarrhea + vomiting, “serious” fever

facts.content: Patient has had four or more bowel movements today and has lost count overall.
facts.source_text: Episodes: ≥4 BMs today; lost count overall

facts.content: Patient has vomited everything including water and tea, with the last episode 2 hours ago post-breakfast.
facts.source_text: Vomiting: everything incl. water/tea; last episode 2 h ago post-breakfast

facts.content: Patient has intermittent periumbilical abdominal pain that precedes the urge to defecate.
facts.source_text: Abdo pain: periumbilical, intermittent, precedes urge to defecate

facts.content: Patient reports no blood in stool or urine.
Patient urinated 1 hour ago with unobserved color and normal frequency.
facts.source_text: Urine: passed 1 h ago; color unobserved; normal frequency

facts.content: Patient has been in contact with a brother who has a similar gastrointestinal illness due to a school outbreak.
facts.source_text: Contact: brother w/ similar GI illness (school outbreak)

facts.content: Patient denies past medical or surgical history, mentions only menstrual cramps.
Patient takes vitamin D daily, PRN ibuprofen, and ORS every 8 hours for the past 2 days.
facts.source_text: Meds: vit D daily; PRN ibuprofen; ORS q8h x2 d

facts.content: Patient is a graphic designer working from home today who lives with her mother and brother.
facts.source_text: SH: Graphic designer; WFH today; lives w/ mother & brother

facts.content: Patient is a non-smoker, consumes alcohol occasionally, and does not use drugs.
Patient's last menstrual period was 2 weeks ago; she is not using contraception and has had no intercourse.
facts.source_text: Gyn: LMP 2 wks ago; no contraception; no intercourse

facts.content: Acute infectious gastroenteritis with ongoing vomiting, diarrhea, and fever, posing a risk of dehydration.
facts.source_text: Acute infectious gastroenteritis w/ ongoing vomiting, diarrhea, fever; dehydration risk.

facts.content: Arrange urgent clinic appointment for hydration assessment and stool sample culture.
facts.source_text: Arrange urgent clinic appt for hydration assessment + stool sample for culture/MC&S.

facts.content: Continue ORS with tiny frequent sips.
Advised on a bland diet: toast, biscuits; avoid fruit, vegetables, and dairy.
facts.source_text: Diet: bland (toast, biscuits); avoid fruit, veg, dairy.

facts.content: Patient advised to visit A&E with red flags: increasing vomiting, reduced urine, dizziness, or worsening pain/fever.
facts.source_text: Red flags → A&E: increasing vomiting, reduced urine, dizziness, worsening pain/fever.

facts.content: Call support line to book appointment; follow-up as needed.
facts.source_text: Call support line to book appt; follow-up prn.
